title: Collapse of the Polynomial Hierarchy
statement: If every language in $\mathrm{coNP}$ is recognized by a polynomial-size family of Boolean circuits with fan-in at most two, using existentially quantified auxiliary input bits, then the polynomial hierarchy satisfies $\mathrm{PH}=\Sigma_3^P$.
hypotheses_covered: Every language in $\mathrm{coNP}$ has a fan-in-two circuit family of polynomial size whose acceptance is characterized by the existence of an auxiliary bit string
